headline: Amazon AWS Capacity Nearly Sold Out Through 2027 Amid AI Demand
summary: Amazon AWS is nearly sold out through 2027 as artificial intelligence demand outpaces cloud capacity, despite plans for $220 billion in capital expenditure in 2026.
why: Amazon Web Services generates a majority of Amazon's operating income and is the world's leading cloud computing provider.

impacts.name: Amazon.com Inc
impacts.why: Unprecedented cloud demand supports multi-year revenue visibility but necessitates enormous upfront capital investments in data centers and chips.
